title: A Unified Exact Factorial-Moment Theory for Multi-set Allocation Occupancy (MAO) in Finite Populations
summary: Let $A_1,\ldots,A_T$ be independent uniformly selected subsets of a finite population of size $n$, with prescribed cardinalities $m_1,\ldots,m_T$. For each population element, define its occupancy level as the number of selected subsets containing it. Let $x_t$ and $x_{\geq t}$ denote the numbers of elements with occupancy exactly $t$ and at least $t$, respectively. The 2025 work introduced a general multi-set allocation occupancy (MAO) representation for higher-order occupancy moments.
